title: Mixed product route through the first-coordinate pushforward
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-trf-admissibility], with $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $A=A_{E,n}$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be proper between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, write $a_X:X\to s$, $a_Y:Y\to s$, and take $K,V\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ and $L\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$. All tensors and operations are derived over $A$ on these constructible domains. Set $K'=Rf_*K$, $Z_X=X\times_sX$, $Z_Y=Y\times_sY$, $U=Y\times_sX$, $q=f\times f$, $r=f\times\operatorname{id}_X:Z_X\to U$, $\pi:U\to Y$ the first projection, and let $p_i,p_i'$ denote the projections from $Z_X,Z_Y$. Use the exact maps $\operatorname{Ku}_!$ of [def-sf-kv-maps] and the projection transformations of [fix-prop-projection-formula]. Put $W=V\otimes f^*L$ and define
$$E_r(B)=\operatorname{Ku}_!(f,\operatorname{id}_X;K,B),\quad J_{Y,X}(B)=\operatorname{Ku}_!(\operatorname{id}_Y,a_X;K',B),$$
$$J_X(B)=\operatorname{Ku}_!(\operatorname{id}_X,a_X;K,B),\quad J_Y(C)=\operatorname{Ku}_!(\operatorname{id}_Y,a_Y;K',C).$$
For every $B\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ one has
$$J_{Y,X}(B)\circ R\pi_!E_r(B)=\operatorname{PF}_{f,K,a_Y^*Ra_{X!}B}^{-1}\circ Rf_!J_X(B).$$
This is an equality of maps from $R\pi_!Rr_!(K\boxtimes B)=Rf_!Rp_{1!}(K\boxtimes B)$ to $K'\otimes a_Y^*Ra_{X!}B$. Here the identification $a_X^*=f^*a_Y^*$ is used on the right, and all compact-support composition and tensor comparisons are the specified geometric comparisons.
